title: Allgäu High Roads
slogan: A 852 km loop out of Allgäu High Roads
story: A proper escape from Munich with roads worth waking up for. Out of Rottach-Egern and back again: 694 km, roughly 14 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Johanniskirchen and Planegg. The climb of the day is Allgäu High Roads. It tops out at about 1,300 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.
